existing_proofs_preserved: Per-program stable softmax includes masked negative-infinity input, max, exp, sum, division, masked store, successful execution and frame. Both original and reciprocal candidate have independent Real formulas; relative FP reciprocal equivalence retains its explicit division rule.

production_stage_mapping.coverage: The full row computation and source masks are represented.
next_power_of_2, warp branches, empty_like and all-row launch are not composed into a public returned-tensor theorem.

dtype_review: Python inherits x storage in y. The materialized kernel/public spec has untyped RegionName/real expressions and no dtype-dependent load, promotion or final store family; the selected default FP rule does not supply all half/bfloat/fp64 paths.
branch_review: The active-column mask and arbitrary positive block size are retained. The host >=2048 and >=4096 warp choices change launch configuration, and their exact selection remains outside the public row contract. This does not demand a proof of autotuner internals.

structural_gaps.finding: The wrapper chooses next_power_of_2(n_cols), two warp branches and allocates y, then launches n_rows programs.
structural_gaps.why_blocks_full_original_scope: Existing per-row IO does not connect those choices to full returned output coverage or wrapper behavior.

structural_gaps.finding: No typed region declaration or storage selector materializes the source-dependent load/reduction/exp/store route.
structural_gaps.why_blocks_full_original_scope: Numeric exp/division assumptions cannot establish missing source dtype dispatch and destination conversion structure.

numerical_items_eligible_for_explicit_de: At represented dtype/configuration, exp approximation, reduction order and division/reciprocal correspondence can be deferred. Masked negative-infinity treatment and exact Real softmax formula are already proved.
precondition_assessment: The existing bounds, nonoverlap, positive tile size and valid-address premises are legitimate selected-domain assumptions. No unrestricted invalid-input behavior or hypothetical hardware defect is demanded. Missing wrapper composition and dtype admission are separate structural questions.
